name: Onoyama Kokoto
source:
Second-year student. Health representative. A classmate of the protagonist's and the younger of the Onoyama twins.

She's the responsible younger sister who's always cleaning up after her older sister's rampages. Though she tends to be shy, she gives a bashful smile whenever she spots the protagonist. Her older sister Kotora speaks in Kansai-ben, but she speaks normally.

She generally gets along well with her older sister, but they often fight when the topic turns to appearance. (While they avoid the topic of breast size, they still argue about other things, like who's taller or shorter.)

She's very conscious about her small breasts and wants to use breastcare to grown them.

She fell in love with the protagonist at first sight. It comforts her that both she and her older sister can like the protagonist without it being a problem, but at the same time, she can't help wanting to have him all for herself.
